_comment: Experimental design. Every suite is a cross-product of its factors; num_seeds instance repetitions per cell. time_limit is the per-run wall-clock budget (seconds).

suites.name: scalability
suites.description: Effect of the number of agents (32x32 random 20% maps, uniform start/goal placement).

suites.name: density
suites.description: Effect of obstacle density at two agent counts.

suites.name: structure
suites.description: Effect of map topology (random / clustered blobs / rooms / maze).

suites.name: distribution
suites.description: Effect of start/goal placement, i.e. of congestion (20 agents, 32x32, 20%).

suites.name: gridsize
suites.description: Effect of map size at fixed density and agent count (agent density varies).

suites.name: priority_orders
suites.description: Ablation over priority-ordering rules for Prioritized Planning (plus the restart variant).

suites.name: adaptive_holdout
suites.description: Mixed-conditions pool used to fit and evaluate the adaptive strategy selector (extension).
